proof_body:
by
  intro a b c a' b' c' hab hab' hcross
  by_cases hc : ∃ x y : ℝ, a * x + b * y = c ∧ a' * x + b' * y = c'
  · right
    obtain ⟨x₀, y₀, h₀, h₀'⟩ := hc
    intro x y
    have key₁ : a' * (a * x + b * y - c) = a * (a' * x + b' * y - c') + 0 := by
      rw [← h₀, ← h₀']; linear_combination (y₀ - y) * hcross
    have key₂ : b' * (a * x + b * y - c) = b * (a' * x + b' * y - c') + 0 := by
      rw [← h₀, ← h₀']; linear_combination (x - x₀) * hcross
    constructor
    · intro h
      have hz : a * x + b * y - c = 0 := by linarith
      rw [hz, mul_zero, add_zero] at key₁ key₂
      have ha := key₁.symm
      have hb := key₂.symm
      have hE : a' * x + b' * y - c' = 0 := by
        by_contra hE
        exact hab ⟨(mul_eq_zero.mp ha).resolve_right hE, (mul_eq_zero.mp hb).resolve_right hE⟩
      linarith
    · intro h
      have hz : a' * x + b' * y - c' = 0 := by linarith
      rw [hz, mul_zero, add_zero] at key₁ key₂
      have hE : a * x + b * y - c = 0 := by
        by_contra hE
        exact hab' ⟨(mul_eq_zero.mp key₁).resolve_right hE, (mul_eq_zero.mp key₂).resolve_right hE⟩
      linarith
  · left
    intro x y h
    exact hc ⟨x, y, h⟩
